Idea title: GasLine — the energy-shock order-rescue system for garment factories
Assessment: Predicts which garment export orders the gas crisis will make late and ranks cheapest rescues; timely, high economic impact.

Idea title: HaorWatch AI: Intelligent Flood Detection and Agricultural Impact Assessment for Bangladesh's Haor Regions
Assessment: Custom model segments floods from Sentinel-1 SAR and overlays ESA WorldCover to estimate farmland exposure in haor regions, with Bangla summaries; real ML, honest scope.

Idea title: Amar Dokan (আমার দোকান): AI Business Assistant for Small Retailers
Assessment: Bangla/Banglish voice bookkeeping for small shops: LLM to strict JSON with confirmation, deterministic money/stock maths, demand forecast and budget-aware restocking; well-scoped with measurable metrics.

Idea title: RxBondhu – AI Reading Aid that Turns Handwritten Prescriptions into a Safe Bangla Medicine Schedule
Assessment: Handwritten prescription reader: BD-trained CNN + VLM + lexicon matching with confidence review and Bangla audio; strong and safe.
FHIR-native platform joining a Bangla voice triage agent with a tracked referral loop across health tiers; excellent problem analysis, but a very large scope for the build window.

All member universities: IIUC, University of Frontier Technology Bangladesh
Idea title: MigGuard An AI-Powered Pre-Departure Protection System for Migrant Workers
Assessment: Checks overseas job offers for migrant workers (OCR + LLM + country rules) with Bangla voice report; high-impact, under-served problem.

Idea title: DENGUE HUNTER — AI-Powered Breeding Site Detection, Risk Prediction & Verified Mosquito Prevention
Assessment: Aedes breeding-site detection from ground/aerial photos with prioritised inspection tasks and before/after checks; relevant public health.

Idea title: Shoi : An Privacy Preserving Bangla AI Voice Chat Assistant For Menstrual Health and Mental Wellness Among Rural Womens
Assessment: Anonymous Bangla voice assistant for menstrual and mental health of rural women with a PCOS risk model and cycle tracking; high impact, but clinical-safety and auto-999 escalation need care.
People-first traffic-signal advisor with BD vehicle detection, simulation-trained timing and Bangla explanations; ambitious but well bounded.

Idea title: FarmMarket – AI-Powered Fair-Price Marketplace and Agricultural Intelligence Platform
Assessment: Working bilingual farm marketplace with explainable matching, price forecasting, RAG assistant, OR-Tools routing and traceability; broad and honest about limits, AI is spread thin across many modules.
